newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila sees GDP rising to at least 7.6 pct in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Manila sees GDP rising to at least 7.6 pct in 1998.

text.p: The Philippines is targetting a gross domestic product (GDP) growth of at least 7.6 percent in 1998 from a 7.1 percent expansion in 1997, documents released by the budget preparation committee showed.
The country registered 4.8 percent GDP growth last year, and is expected to post 6.0 percent growth this year.
The government said a double-digit expansion in the industrial sector would lead to robust growth. The committee was projecting a 10.3 percent industrial growth next year and 10.7 percent in 1998.
Agriculture would show rising growth rates of 3.7 percent in 1997 and 4.0 percent in 1998. The services sector would grow 6.0 percent next year and 6.5 percent the year after, it said.
The projections are being used by the committee to prepare budget proposals for the corresponding years.
